D: A playboy millionaire must choose between his fortune and the working-class woman he loves.
P: Serve dessert when Hobson says something devastatingly dry.
S: the engagement party Arthur drinks his way through

Thin rye cut into squares, buttered, topped with smoked salmon, a dot of crème fraîche whipped with lemon, dill and cracked pepper. Butter 6 slices rye bread and cut into small squares. Top with 200g smoked salmon. Whip 100ml crème fraîche with lemon zest and put a dot on each, then add a dill sprig and cracked pepper. Serve cold.
Warm buckwheat blini at 180C for 5 minutes, top with crème fraîche, caviar or salmon roe and snipped chives.
Hobson the butler, keeping Arthur's world properly civilised

Crustless white bread with herbed cream cheese, paper-thin cucumber and peppery cress, cut into neat fingers. Peel and very thinly slice 1 telegraph cucumber, salt lightly for 10 minutes and pat dry. Beat 150g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped dill, lemon zest and pepper. Spread over 12 slices white bread. Top 6 with cucumber and a punnet of cress, close with the rest and press gently. Cut off the crusts and slice into 4 fingers each.
M: Arthur's big news, met with a very dry reply

Topside seasoned and roasted at 200C to 52C inside, rested, sliced thin, Yorkshire puddings and gravy. Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C until 52C inside, about an hour, and rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk, pour into very hot oiled tins and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock and pan juices.
Linda, the waitress who shoplifted a tie

Corned beef, Swiss and sauerkraut on rye with Russian dressing, fried in butter until crisp and melting. Mix 80g mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish and 1 tbsp chopped gherkin for the dressing. Butter 8 slices rye on one side. On the unbuttered side spread dressing, then layer 400g sliced corned beef, 200g drained sauerkraut and 8 slices Swiss. Close and fry over medium heat for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and melted.
W: 600ml cream infused with vanilla over 6 yolks and 80g sugar, baked in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes, chilled overnight, caster sugar torched to amber.
K: Arthur drinks whatever's open, and champagne is always open

Crème de cassis in a chilled flute, topped with brut champagne and a fresh raspberry dropped in. Chill 4 flutes in the freezer for 10 minutes. Pour 15ml crème de cassis into each glass. Tilt each flute and top slowly with 120ml chilled brut champagne so it doesn't foam over, then let it settle. Drop a fresh raspberry into each glass so it bobs in the bubbles and serve straight away, before the fizz fades.

Warm 16 buckwheat blini on a tray at 180C for 5 minutes. Top each with a teaspoon of crème fraîche, about 150ml in all, half a teaspoon of salmon roe and a few snipped chives. Serve straight away on a silver tray if you have one.

m.note: Arthur's big news, met with a very dry reply
m.how: Roast a 1.5kg topside at 200C until 52C inside, about an hour, and rest 20 minutes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk, pour into very hot oiled tins and bake at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock and pan juices.

w.how: Warm 600ml cream with a split vanilla bean. Whisk 6 yolks with 80g sugar and pour the cream over. Pour into 4 ramekins and bake in a water bath at 150C for 35 minutes. Chill overnight, then sprinkle with sugar and torch to amber.
